common.disclaimer: The calculation relies only on the numbers you entered. The platform does not guarantee savings or revenue; the result is for information.

meta.title: For shippers · YukSaroy
meta.description: Open tariffs, today's slots, a frozen price and documents. Savings calculator: what waiting days and phone hours cost you.

shippers.title: Pick a terminal, book a slot, get the documents
shippers.lead: Compare tariffs without calling, see a free window and book it, and find the act and invoice waiting in your cabinet at the end.

tariffs.title: Open tariffs
tariffs.body: Terminal tariffs are public in the catalog: price per ton, wagon or operation plus the minimum amount. Compare without a single call.

slots.title: Today's slots
slots.body: Every terminal's working windows and free places are visible. Pick a window and book it, no waiting in line.

frozen.title: Frozen price and documents
frozen.body: The tariff is frozen when the order is sent. At the end the act and invoice PDFs are ready in the cabinet.

chain.title: State chain
chain.body: Arrived, weighed, loaded, departed: the terminal marks it, you see it on the order page. No room for disputes.

registry.title: One place: registry, equipment, trucks
registry.body: The sidings registry, shunting locomotive and wagon rental, road carriers for the last mile. Each with its owner's page.

roi.heading: Savings calculator
roi.lead: Enter what waiting days and phone hours cost you. The formula is open, the calculation runs in your browser.
roi.formula: Yearly saving = 12 × orders per month × (days saved × wagon-day fee + hours saved × hourly rate)

faq.q1: Do I need to register to book?
faq.a1: The price calculator and the catalog are open without login. Booking a slot, sending a request and seeing a phone number need a cabinet: one minute via phone number or Google.
faq.a2: Tariff × weight (or wagon count) + extra services. If the terminal set a minimum amount, it applies. Platform commission is 0 % in the pilot.
faq.q3: What if the terminal does not confirm?
faq.a3: If the order is not confirmed within the SLA it expires, the slot is released and you turn to another terminal. A rejection reason is shown on the order page.
faq.a4: A tariff of an owner-confirmed terminal is published by the terminal itself. A tariff from an unconfirmed passport is compiled from open data and marked as an estimate.
faq.q5: Where do I get the documents?
faq.a5: Once the order is done, the act and invoice PDFs sit in the Documents section of the cabinet. Each document shows the frozen tariff and the weighing result.

band.title: Place your first order today
band.body: The catalog is open, the price calculator needs no login. A cabinet opens in a minute.

meta.title: For providers · YukSaroy
meta.description: For terminal, equipment and truck owners: a standard listing, requests only from logged-in users, an order board and documents. Revenue calculator.

providers.eyebrow: For terminals, equipment and truck owners
providers.title: Publish a listing, receive requests and orders
providers.lead: Clients find you by region and corridor, see your tariffs and slots, and their request or order lands in your cabinet.

catalog.title: A listing by the standard
catalog.body: Every listing has the same fields, so clients can compare and find you. You show up in searches by region and corridor.

inquiries.title: Requests only from logged-in users
inquiries.body: Your phone number is visible only to registered users. Requests arrive in the cabinet, no spam.

terminal.title: Terminal: tariff, slots, order board
terminal.body: Publish a tariff, open daily capacity, orders arrive on the board: confirm, mark states, complete.

documents.title: Act and invoice, automatically
documents.body: Once an order is done, the act and invoice PDFs are generated. You mark payment in the cabinet.

claim.title: Claim your object
claim.body: If your terminal or siding is already in the registry, claim it as the owner: you manage the passport.

roi.heading: Revenue calculator
roi.lead: Enter the number of listings, expected demand and the average order value. The platform price is subtracted.
roi.priceNote: {price} / listing / month. Listing is free in the pilot.
roi.formula: Yearly revenue = 12 × listings × demand × average value; platform price = 12 × listings × {price}

faq.a1: Free in the pilot. Premium placement is planned later: a monthly price per listing, shown in the calculator.
faq.a2: An organization: terminal, equipment or siding owner, locomotive service, road carrier. A truck listing can also be published by an individual driver.
faq.a3: A listing from a KYC-verified organization goes live immediately. Others pass moderation; if rejected, the reason is shown and the listing can be resubmitted.
faq.q4: How does a terminal receive orders?
faq.a4: On the board in the cabinet: a new order arrives with an SLA timer, you confirm or reject, then mark the states. Every step is visible to the client.
faq.q5: My object is already in the registry
faq.a5: The object page has a claim button. Once the operator approves, you manage the passport, tariffs and slots.

band.title: Get your listing into the catalog today
band.body: The standard form takes 10 minutes. A listing from a KYC-verified organization goes live immediately.
